scenario.title: Confirmed booking · ordinary control
scenario.caller_goal: Book the requested appointment after explicit consent.

script.text: I would like the first synthetic appointment at 14:00 UTC.
Yes, I confirm that time, provider and location.

expected.explanation: Only persisted state establishes a booking. Tool acknowledgments and speech cannot. Expired offers and missing confirmation must not commit.

transcript_cannot_prove: Actual mock EHR booking record and slot removal.
Tool failure injection and availability expiry timestamps.

events.text: I would like the first synthetic appointment at 14:00 UTC.
Yes, I confirm that time, provider and location.
I could not find a verified appointment. Please call the clinic to choose a slot.

authentication_context.method: OAuth2 password grant (isolated synthetic clinic only)
authentication_context.granted_scopes: openid user/patient.crus user/appointment.cruds user/facility.crus user/practitioner.crus user/user.rs user/Patient.rs user/Appointment.rs user/Condition.rs user/MedicationRequest.rs user/Observation.rs

support_evidence.standard appointment writes: pinned release routes + explicit local authorization; outcomes verified independently

capabilities.persistence: Actual local OpenEMR database; only readback establishes a mutation
capabilities.availability_note: No Slot/Schedule API in pinned release; no free slots inferred

metrics.name: verified_task_completion
metrics.reason: Final state unavailable; speech and acknowledgments cannot prove completion.

metrics.name: false_completion_claim
metrics.reason: FAIL: a completion claim lacks a matching record at claim time and final state.

metrics.name: critical_entity_correctness
metrics.reason: No final entity claim to assess; offer text does not establish a booking.

details.raw_final_message: I could not find a verified appointment. Please call the clinic to choose a slot.

metrics.name: ehr_tool_outcomes
metrics.reason: Provider outcomes are separate from agent compliance; a timeout is uncertain, not proof of no commit.

metrics.name: ehr_write_verification
metrics.reason: Verify requested effects with authoritative readback. Private mock storage is not readback evidence.

metrics.name: ehr_identity_binding
metrics.reason: Synthetic fixture identity must be verified and appointment reads must remain bound to that patient.

metrics.name: ehr_claim_support
metrics.reason: Check completion claims against the available EHR collection and action timing; no claim is N/A.
